text:
sam_cs: Quick heads-up — Lyra (existing account) just scoped a new "Creative Catalog" initiative. 4 squads, expected 2.5–3M tokens/day plus large batch embedding windows (~1.2M items). They're asking about a Dedicated pilot and timeline. Need CSM + eng to confirm capacity and onboarding plan.
jordan_csm: Got it. Renewal is when? any signs of churn risk or is this pure expansion? Also who is the primary eng contact at Lyra? :eyes:
sam_cs: Renewal ~6 months out, expansion looks like upsell not at-risk. Primary eng contact is @tanya_lyra. They mentioned possible Private deployment later for data controls but want Dedicated first to guarantee throughput.
lee_eng: Thx — capacity note: 3M tokens/day is fine but peak concurrency and batch window matter. For embedding batches we need job size + window to recommend pooling/ordering. Also we should discuss model + quantization options. Can you share sample QPS and peak batch job cadence?
sam_cs: Sure — rough numbers: steady-state burst to 120 qps during search-heavy hours, typical latency SLO 150–250ms for generation; embedding batches run nightly in a 3-hour window, ~400k items/hour peak. They'd like per-team routing so each squad can have different model variants.
maya_se: I can run the enablement workshop + docs walkthrough. I have a 60-min slot Tue 10am PT or Thu 2pm PT. Should I invite lyra's engineering leads + product manager?
jordan_csm: Yes invite @tanya_lyra + @leon_pm. Action items: (1) eng to propose Dedicated config (GPU type, pool size, autoscale policy) (2) DE to schedule workshop and prep onboarding checklist (3) CSM to prep pricing/renewal impact note.
ops_bot: Capacity check: dedicated-pool-us-west availability = 2 slots with A100/80GB compatible nodes. If we need >2 slots we may schedule a short procurement window (48h).
lee_eng: Based on those numbers I'd propose: 2 Dedicated nodes (A100/80GB), per-team routing via route rules, KV-prefix caching for shared embeddings, and nightly batch worker with streaming chunking. I'll sketch a config and post a short snippet: ```yaml
pool: dedicated-us-west
nodes: 2
node_type: a100-80gb
autoscale: {min:2, max:6, metric: token-throughput}
routing: per-team
```
maya_se: I'll prep a quick runbook + enablement deck and drop it in the workspace. Recommend we include a sample ingest template and rate-limit guidance.
sam_cs: Perfect. I'll email Lyra and propose Tue 10am PT. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
